negative_findings.description: Targeted Macedonian-language searching for KIBS procurement ('КИБС Клириншка куќа Скопје јавна набавка') returned no tender or procurement page. A direct fetch of the KIBS news page showed only a 'ВЕСТИ И ПРОМОЦИИ' section with no procurement notices.
negative_findings.result_summary: KIBS appears to publish no public tender channel; as a joint-stock company owned by banks it is likely outside the Public Procurement Law's contracting-authority scope, so its buying is invisible in ЕСЈН.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payments-rail demand at the clearing house must be inferred indirectly (news, vendor press releases, NBRM oversight reports, shareholder-bank disclosures) rather than tracked from tender feeds.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language search 'Централен депозитар за хартии од вредност тендер ИТ систем' surfaced only corporate/organisational pages, an MSE issuer profile and NBRM's description of CDHV — no tender listing.
negative_findings.result_summary: No CDHV tender portal identified in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CSD system-replacement opportunities will have to be picked up from MSE-published annual reports and shareholder-meeting materials, not from a procurement feed.

negative_findings.description: Search for NBRM's own procurement notices ('Народна банка ... јавни набавки МИПС платен систем оглас') did not return an NBRM javni-nabavki page; results were general MIPS/central-bank pages plus unrelated commercial bank PDFs.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBRM procurement page URL not confirmed. NBRM is expected to publish either on its own site or in ЕСЈН.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: NBRM operates MIPS (RTGS) and is a high-value buyer; missing its procurement channel would be a material blind spot.

negative_findings.description: The appeals commission appeared under three hostnames in results: dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk, and a vendor-hosted dkzjn.sorsix.com. Similarly KIBS appeared as both kibs.mk and kibs.com.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical hostnames unresolved; none of these were fetched, so none should be treated as dead or as duplicates without a verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collectors pointed at a non-canonical host risk silent data loss when it is retired.

negative_findings.description: The term 'куќа' in 'Клириншка куќа' is highly polysemous — the KIBS query returned an Airbnb guest-house listing. 'Депозитар' and 'набавка' are cleaner. 'Тендер' is used less than 'оглас'/'јавна набавка' in official MK sources.
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary note: prefer 'јавна набавка', 'оглас', 'договор за јавна набавка', 'ЕСЈН' over 'тендер'; always pair 'Клириншка куќа' with 'КИБС'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query hygiene materially changes recall in the Macedonian corpus.

brief: For North Macedonia's payment-rail and state-IT cell the source landscape splits cleanly in two. The public half is well served: ЕСЈН (e-nabavki.gov.mk) is the mandatory central e-procurement system, flanked by the Public Procurement Bureau, the appeals commission ДКЖЈН (which publishes complaints and decisions and exposes contested IT tenders), and the State Audit Office, whose dedicated IT audits are the richest open description of the state's information systems; the Ministry of Digital Transformation — successor to МИОА since 2024 — publishes its own procurement plans and runs uslugi.gov.mk, TrustEID and the interoperability agenda. The private half is opaque: neither КИБС (clearing house, also the country's first certification authority) nor ЦДХВ (the CSD) shows any tender channel, so their modernisation demand must be inferred from company news, KIBSTrust policy documents, NBRM oversight material and — for CDHV, a listed issuer — its mandatory disclosures on the Macedonian Stock Exchange. Donor channels (EBRD ECEPP, World Bank procurement plans, EU/IPA publications) are the earliest-warning layer, often naming packages years before national tendering. Main open risks: NBRM's own procurement page is unlocated, the Official Gazette and any open-data export of ЕСЈН are unchecked, and all URLs here await the deterministic liveness pass.
